name: caroule
description: Ça Roule : jeu mobile de puzzle de parking (Course, Casse-tête, défi du jour)

scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e-run-touch.js && node tests/e2e-puzzle-touch.js && node tests/e2e-puzzle-mouse.js && node tests/e2e-levels-sheet.js && node tests/e2e-kit.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run verify:course && npm run verify:daily && npm run verify && npm run test:e2e
scripts.add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android && npm run admob:config
scripts.add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npm run admob:config
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
